places.name: Batumi Boulevard Promenade
places.ai_summary: A scenic seaside promenade featuring lush greenery, fountains, and a vibrant atmosphere, perfect for leisurely strolls and relaxation.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during sunrise or sunset for stunning views.

places.place_tip: Rent a bicycle to explore the entire promenade effortlessly.

places.name: Ali & Nino Moving Sculpture
places.ai_summary: A mesmerizing kinetic sculpture symbolizing eternal love, located along the Batumi Boulevard.

opening_hours.notes: Illuminated at night for a magical experience.

places.place_tip: Visit during sunset for the most romantic ambiance.

places.name: Batumi Botanical Garden
places.ai_summary: A sprawling botanical garden showcasing diverse flora from around the world, offering breathtaking views of the Black Sea.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours available for an enhanced experience.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for exploring the vast garden trails.

places.name: Europe Square & Astronomical Clock
places.ai_summary: A central square in Batumi featuring the Astronomical Clock, surrounded by beautiful architecture and vibrant life.

opening_hours.notes: The clock tower is illuminated at night.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a coffee at one of the nearby cafes for a great view of the square.

places.name: Piazza Square
places.ai_summary: A charming square in Batumi known for its Italian architecture, vibrant atmosphere, and the famous Piazza Tower.

opening_hours.notes: Visit the tower for panoramic views of the city.

places.place_tip: Try the local gelato from a nearby vendor.

attribution.title: Piazza San Marco (Venice) at night-msu-2021-6449-
attribution.author: Matthias Süßen

places.name: Alphabet Tower
places.ai_summary: A modern symbol of Batumi, this tower is adorned with the letters of the Georgian alphabet and offers stunning views from the top.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Don't forget to take a photo with the tower in the background.

places.name: Batumi Beach & Seaside Park
places.ai_summary: A popular beach destination in Batumi, featuring a long pebble beach, clear waters, and a lively seaside park.

opening_hours.notes: Lifeguards on duty during the day.

places.place_tip: Visit the beach early to secure a good spot.

places.name: Gonio Fortress
places.ai_summary: An ancient fortress located near Batumi, offering a glimpse into the region's history and stunning views of the coastline.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with a trip to the nearby beach.

places.name: Argo Cable Car & Panorama
places.ai_summary: A cable car ride offering panoramic views of Batumi, the Black Sea, and the surrounding mountains.

opening_hours.notes: Last ride down is at 20:00.

places.place_tip: Book a round trip to enjoy the views both ways.

places.name: Batumi Dolphinarium
places.ai_summary: A popular attraction in Batumi, featuring dolphin shows and the opportunity to swim with dolphins.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking recommended for swimming with dolphins.

places.place_tip: Bring a swimsuit if you plan to swim with the dolphins.

places.name: 6 May Park & Zoo
places.ai_summary: A large park in Batumi featuring a zoo, amusement park, and beautiful walking paths.

opening_hours.notes: The zoo has separate opening hours.

places.place_tip: Check the zoo schedule for feeding times of the animals.

places.name: Chacha Tower
places.ai_summary: A famous tower in Batumi known for its unique architecture and the Chacha liquor served at the top.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed at sunset.

places.place_tip: Try the local Chacha liquor at the top of the tower.

places.name: Batumi Old Town
places.ai_summary: The historical district of Batumi, featuring charming streets, old buildings, and a vibrant atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Explore the narrow streets and enjoy the local cafes.

places.place_tip: Visit the Batumi Piazza for a coffee break.

places.name: Holy Mother Virgin Nativity Cathedral
places.ai_summary: A beautiful cathedral in Batumi, known for its stunning architecture and serene atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Dress modestly when visiting the cathedral.

places.place_tip: Light a candle for good luck inside the cathedral.

places.name: Batumi Art Museum
places.ai_summary: A modern art museum in Batumi, showcasing contemporary Georgian and international art.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Tuesdays.

places.place_tip: Check for temporary exhibitions during your visit.

attribution.title: Batumi Stalin Museum
attribution.author: Ephraim Stillberg
attribution.description: Entrance to the Stalin museum in Batumi, Georgia

places.name: Miracle Park
places.ai_summary: A beautiful park in Batumi featuring a variety of plants, walking paths, and the famous Batumi Ferris Wheel.

opening_hours.notes: The Ferris Wheel has separate operating hours.

places.place_tip: Take a ride on the Ferris Wheel for a stunning view of the city.

places.name: Mtirala National Park
places.ai_summary: A stunning national park near Batumi, known for its rich biodiversity, hiking trails, and beautiful landscapes.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours available for an enhanced experience.

places.place_tip: Bring water and snacks for the hike.

attribution.title: Waterfall in Mtirala National Park

places.name: Batumi Boulevard Bicycling Path
places.ai_summary: A dedicated bicycling path along the Batumi Boulevard, offering a fun and active way to explore the area.

opening_hours.notes: Best enjoyed in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Bring your own bicycle or rent one from a nearby shop.

places.name: Orta Jame Mosque
places.ai_summary: A historic mosque in Batumi, known for its beautiful architecture and serene courtyard.

opening_hours.notes: Dress modestly and remove shoes before entering.

places.place_tip: Visit during prayer times for a more spiritual experience.

places.name: Sunset Cruise on Black Sea
places.ai_summary: A relaxing cruise on the Black Sea, offering stunning views of the sunset and the Batumi coastline.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking recommended, especially in peak season.

places.place_tip: Bring a light jacket as it can get chilly on the water.
